usual_baseline: About half are checked: 23.33% [3118], 41–52% [1363, 3355], 43–47% [3200, 3588], up to 80.6% [3357]. Baseline before starting is 43–44.4% [3167, 3200]; 12-week check 12% [3599]. Raised results are often not acted on: action 27.3% [3167], 41.7% [3357]; symptoms assessed 9.1% [3167].
fix_that_works: Trust-wide recommendations after a 2021 audit (not described): monitoring 47% and 43% to 100% (n=160) [3588].
fix_that_fails: Re-audit with no described intervention: 41% to 51% [3355]; 69% to 76% on admission [3633]. Even at 100% testing, raised prolactin was managed in only 4 of 9 [3588]. Symptom documentation stayed poor [3633].
consultant_advice: Testing rates are well documented and ten audits say the same. The real gap is what happens after a raised result: symptoms asked, action taken, repeat test. Audit that, with a named pathway or electronic prompt, and re-audit it.
